result.document_summary: Jersey City Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations web page that administers the city's Rent Control Ordinance (Chapter 260), noting that 1-4 unit properties are exempt and listing registration and rent-increase application forms.
result.notes: The page is an administrative landing page and does not reproduce the text of Chapter 260, so no rent cap formula, effective date or full list of exemptions is stated; the only substantive coverage statement is that all 1-4 unit properties are exempt. The state liability-insurance requirement (N.J.S.A. 40A:10A-1) and landlord registration requirements are outside the six in-scope categories and were not extracted. Confidence is moderate because the page only summarizes the ordinance.

rules.title: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance (Chapter 260)
rules.requirement: The city administers and enforces a rent control ordinance that regulates rent increases, with landlord applications for capital improvement, vacancy and hardship increases and tenant petitions for illegal rent. Properties with 1-4 units are exempt from rent control.
rules.quoted_span:
The Office of Landlord Tenant Relations administers and enforces the
Rent Control Ordinance, Chapter 260
of the Jersey City Municipal Code
rules.coverage_text: Applies to rental properties in Jersey City with five or more units; all 1-4 unit properties are exempt, and other exemptions may be requested if criteria in the ordinance are met.

exemptions.label: 1-4 unit properties are exempt from rent control

all_of.text: All 1-4 Unit Properties are exempt from rent control

rules.exemptions_text: All 1-4 unit properties are exempt; the ordinance provides other permitted exemptions that an owner may request from the Office, but the page does not list them.
